title: Projektetage Resize Handles Alignment
description: Fix interactive resize on projektetage: content scales uniformly inside the frame (no text reflow overshoot); resize handles aligned with selection chrome.
summary:
Fixed resize handles for catalogue split grids and intro flow title drag.

Catalogue (prior): split-group / per-tile layout, canvas-framed CSS, gesturing chrome.

Intro flow title (this fix): dragging stored pixel offsets on the wrapper while chrome fell back to `inset: 0` on the full-width wrapper (handles jumped off the title or used pixel values as % and vanished).

- Flow drag keeps chrome on measured ink bounds via `transformFrameStyle(measuredNatural)`; wrapper alone uses `translate3d` for pixel offset.
- `isFlowPixelOffsetTransform` detects px translate without requiring registry measured rect.
- Chrome stays visible while gesturing (`selected || gesturing`).
- `clusterSplitTilesByVisualRow` exported from presentation core.

48 renderer + 42 core tests pass.
